verdict.rationale: Aleph's docs say it can save dashboards and reports for the team (aleph-docs-7) and share key metrics through dashboards (aleph-docs-19). They also describe team and user permissions and fine-grained access controls (aleph-docs-18, aleph-docs-25), and board-ready variance analysis (aleph-docs-3). However, nothing ties those permissions to dashboard sharing, and nothing shows reports being delivered to board members outside the company. Missing for 10: documented per-dashboard or per-report scoped sharing, board or external viewer access (e.g. links or guest seats), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
